articles.title: Hackers Use Fake Firefox Wallet Extensions to Steal Crypto Recovery Phrases
articles.summary:

The add-ons posed as wallet portals, desktop tools, and browser utilities, while hidden code attempted to send the secrets to attacker-controlled Cloudflare Workers.
